security.title: Security Policy
security.password1: Passwords must be at least 8 characters long.
security.password2: We recommend using a mix of uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and symbols.
security.password3: Passwords are stored using BCrypt — we never store them in plain text.
security.session1: Authentication tokens (JWT) are signed with HS256 and have a lifetime of 24 hours.
security.session2: Tokens are stored in your browser's localStorage and are attached to every API request via the Authorization header.
security.session3: Logging out clears the token from localStorage and the access_token cookie immediately. Tokens are stateless; there is no server-side revocation before expiry.
security.data1: We store your name, email address, phone number (optional), and hashed password on our servers.
security.data2: Trip, reservation, and payment records are retained to provide the service and resolve disputes.
security.data3: Card data is never stored on our servers. Payment tokenization is handled entirely by Mercado Pago.
security.report1: If you discover a vulnerability or suspect your account has been compromised, please contact us immediately.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.legal1: This policy is governed by Colombia's Ley 1581 de 2012 (Habeas Data Law) and its regulatory decrees.
privacy.legal2: By registering on the platform you explicitly consent to the collection and use of your personal data as described below.
privacy.collected1: Identity data: full name, national ID number.
privacy.collected2: Contact data: email address, phone number.
privacy.collected3: Usage data: trips created or booked, reservation history, payment records.
privacy.collected4: Technical data: IP address, browser type, access timestamps (collected automatically by our infrastructure).
privacy.use1: To provide the carpooling service: matching passengers with drivers, processing reservations, and handling payments.
privacy.use2: To communicate with you: email verification, password reset, reservation confirmations, and service notifications.
privacy.use3: We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes.
privacy.thirdPartyMP: Processes payments on our behalf. Your card data is sent directly to Mercado Pago and is never stored on our servers. See mercadopago.com.co for their privacy policy.
privacy.thirdPartyGoogle: Used for Sign in with Google. If you authenticate via Google, we receive your name and email address from Google's OAuth service.
privacy.rights1: You have the right to access, correct, update, or delete your personal data at any time.
privacy.rights2: To exercise these rights, contact us at

cancellations.title: Cancellation & Refund Policy
cancellations.who1: Passengers can cancel their own reservations at any time before the trip departs, subject to the time windows below.
cancellations.who2: Drivers can cancel a scheduled trip. When a driver cancels, all confirmed reservations on that trip are automatically cancelled and passengers become eligible for a full refund.
cancellations.window1: More than 2 hours before departure: full refund.
cancellations.window2: Between 30 minutes and 2 hours before departure: 50% refund.
cancellations.window3: Less than 30 minutes before departure or after the trip has started: no refund.
cancellations.refund1: Passenger cancels within the eligible time window after a confirmed (paid) reservation.
cancellations.refund2: Driver cancels the trip after at least one paid reservation exists.
cancellations.refund3: A payment is approved but the trip is subsequently cancelled by the platform or driver.
cancellations.processing1: Refunds are returned to the original payment method used at checkout.
cancellations.processing2: Credit and debit card refunds typically take 3–10 business days to appear on your statement, depending on your bank.
cancellations.noRefund1: Cancellations made less than 30 minutes before departure or after the trip has started are not eligible for a refund.
cancellations.noRefund2: If a reservation was never paid (status PENDING_PAYMENT), no monetary refund is issued — the held seat is simply released.

recovery.title: Account Recovery
recovery.reset1: Go to the login page and click "Forgot password?".
recovery.reset2: Enter your registered email address and submit the form.
recovery.reset3: Check your inbox for a reset link. The link is valid for 1 hour.
recovery.reset4: Click the link, enter your new password (minimum 8 characters), and confirm. You will be redirected to login.
recovery.locked1: If you no longer have access to your registered email address, automated recovery is not possible.
recovery.locked2: In this case, contact our support team to verify your identity through an alternative process.
recovery.google1: If you registered using Google OAuth and your Google account email changes, your Ruta Compartida UQ account will no longer be linked to your new email.
recovery.google2: This happens because we store the email provided at registration time; a Google email change does not automatically update our records.
recovery.google3: To relink your account or transfer your data, contact us at
recovery.verification1: Verification links are valid for 24 hours. If your link has expired, go to the login page and use the "Resend verification email" option.
recovery.verification2: If verification emails are not arriving, check your spam or junk folder. Add studioflowia@gmail.com to your contacts to prevent future filtering.
